[{"insert":"Strict Bar Dip Progression

The final dip session of the cycle in a cluster format, resting seventy five seconds between short heavy sets. Descending reps within each cluster let you handle the hardest dips of the block by adding weight or dropping assistance. Keep every rep strict and full depth even as the load climbs. This should be your heaviest dip work of the six weeks.
"}]
